title: Zephyrine and the Inheritance
author: Marguerite Winterbourne
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
